text:
What beast felled by astonishment

crawls through my blood

and wants to save itself?


Here is what is difficult:

to walk through the streets

and point to the sky or the earth.

translation.title: The Only Wound
translation.editorial_note: Caída de pasmo becomes felled by astonishment, holding shock and wonder together; the inner beast’s rescue contrasts with the ordinary impossibility of pointing outward.
